exposure: Introduction of a nationwide surgical task-sharing initiative
outcome: Proportion of operations performed by public vs. private sector
Type of surgical provider (non-specialised physician vs. associate clinician)
cohort: All healthcare facilities with an operating theatre in Sierra Leone were included in this nationwide study.
finding: Over the last decade, Sierra Leone experienced a shift in surgical care with increased volume, a transition from general to obstetric surgeries, from private to public institutions, and an expansion of surgical care in rural areas, largely led by associate clinicians, attributed to the surgical task-sharing initiative.
mod_finding: Nationwide caesarean section rates increased from 1.4% in 2012 to 5.3% in 2023, with the majority in 2023 performed in public facilities by associate clinicians.
